senses.gloss: P. b. Judah, the alleged husband of the mother of Jesus of Nazareth.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104b:5">Sabb. 104ᵇ</cite> (missing in editions under censorial supervision).

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 5:9">Tosef. Sot. V, 9</cite> <he>כגון פ׳ בן י׳ שהיה נועל וכ׳</he> (not <he>שנועל</he>) like P. b. J. who locked the door before his wife (refused to live with her on account of a suspicion); Y. ib. I, 17ᵃ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:6:7">Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ</cite> <he>והודה בן פ׳</he>; <cite ref="Gittin 90a:15">Gitt. 90ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בן י׳</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:12">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>י׳ בן פ׳</he>.

senses.gloss: Pappus (ben Judah), mentioned in connection with לוּלְיָינוֹס, q. v. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 2, ch. V; Y. Taan. II, 66ᵃ top פיפוס (corr. acc.); a. fr.
Pappus, father of R. Judah, a contemporary of R. Joshua.
